description: This file defines the ChatActivity class for an Android chat application. The class manages UI components for messaging and media sharing, including message input, message display, and media selection from the device gallery. It includes placeholder logic for sending messages and media.

classes.name: ChatActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity for messaging, including text and media sharing, with UI components like message list, input field, and media button.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes chat activity UI, sets up event listeners for send button and media button, populates chat title.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result of media picker intent, placeholder for sending media.
